name: The Stone of Golorr (Internal Mechanics)
description: An ancient Aboleth transformed into a sentient memory stone, currently psychically tethered to the monk Sudara[cite: 3, 4]. It is an alien, arrogant intelligence that remembers the cosmos before the gods[cite: 3].
key_facts: When an eye is socketed into the Stone, it attempts a violent 'Neural Overwrite' on the wielder, flooding their brain with cold, pressurized water and ancient Abolethic memories[cite: 2, 4].
Sudara successfully repelled the overwrite through monastic discipline, but the connection left a permanent 'psychic scar' that acts as a heat map for secrets[cite: 2, 4].
This psychic resonance acts as a beacon, putting the wielder on the radar of high-CR psionic predators in Waterdeep, including the Skum Lord, Mnemonicus-Vrax, and Slyth-vyrr[cite: 4].
The Stone actively seeks to be 'made whole' and manipulates its wielder into recovering its missing eyes, offering cosmic secrets and immense power in exchange[cite: 4].
gm_notes: This lore dictates how the Stone functions magically. It is not just a magic item; it is a biological, psychic parasite that wants to use the party to exact revenge on Neverember and the factions that blinded it.
